notes.title: New Game Announcement: 'Causality'
notes.content:
[i][b]Please Note:[/b] This is a cross-promotion post.[/i]


Greetings from the publisher PsychoFlux Entertainment!

We would like to announce that today, we have released our new game '[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1158720/Causality/]Causality[/url][/b]' on Steam.

[previewyoutube=Oe4pXYrUciA;full][/previewyoutube]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1158720/Causality/

Developed by [url=https://store.steampowered.com/dev/WAFFLE]WAFFLE GAMES[/url], Causality is a game where you must rescue 3 students trapped in a school full of mysterious psychic phenomena, while you're running away from ghosts, avoiding some traps, and solving puzzles here and there.

The real story behind the school and the causal relationship of the events, is all in your hands. Uncover the secrets hidden behind!

[td][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1158720/ss_d731d9aeb5a4a95d7972250384f2ea3dd9556144.jpg[/img][/td]

[/table]
As you might have noticed, Causality is also a horror adventure game made with RPG Maker, just like Cat in the Box. If you enjoyed playing it, then you will definitely love this one too!

If you're interested, then please have a look on the game's store page. Purchasing or wishlisting the game would be much appreciated!

English, Korean, and Japanese languages are supported.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1158720/Causality/

Thank you very much.

notes.title: Cat in the Box Soundtrack is out!
notes.content:
Cat in the Box's digital soundtrack is out! The soundtrack was co-produced by Majesty and Gustav(the developer himself).

Actually the soundtrack was released few days ago, but we found some mixing issues on several tracks and replaced them to new ones recently. So finally we can let you know it's officially out. :)

If you already own the game, then you can purchase the soundtrack at the discounted price by completing our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/13344/Cat_in_the_Box_Digital_Deluxe_Edition/]Digital Deluxe Edition bundle[/url] by this weekend. The bundle type will be switched to must-purchase-together on Monday, so don't miss this limited-time offer!

Oh, and please note that you can also get the soundtrack on our [url=https://psychoflux.bandcamp.com/album/cat-in-the-box-soundtrack]Bandcamp[/url], or stream it on our [url=https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLIyeJWmp-_VjO8aNDochwS3PgMumCkD68]YouTube channel[/url]!

Thanks a lot!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1257420/Cat_in_the_Box_Soundtrack/

notes.title: [EDITED] Announcement Regarding Livestream and Video
notes.content:
[i][b]Edited 2020-05-04:[/b] After the discussion with the developer, we decided to lift every embargoes. Feel free to produce any video contents related to Cat in the Box![/i]


[strike]As you can guess by the tags applied to our Steam store page, Cat in the Box has multiple endings.

If you're a Streamer or YouTuber, you can progress as much as you want and watch several endings together with your viewers. However, please note that revealing [b]every[/b] endings or secrets is not recommended while you're livestreaming or recording videos.

If that wasn't clear, here are some examples.

[b]FINE:[/b]
[list][*] Watching 2~3 endings by selecting different choices at the end of the game

[*] Finding some secrets or unlocking achievements while playing

[*] Uploading your normal 【 let's play / walkthrough 】 video[/list]

[b]NOT OK:[/b]
[list][*] Watch some endings, and then starting a new game from the beginning to find every possible 【 endings / secrets / achievements 】

[*] Uploading the 【 compilation / guide 】 video that only shows 【 ending scenes / secrets / achievements 】 of the game and 【 where / how 】 to find them[/list]


Feel free to ask us if you're still unsure.[/strike]

Thanks for playing our game!


[i]P. S.[/i] Cat in the Box has its [url=https://www.twitch.tv/directory/game/Cat%20in%20the%20Box]own category on Twitch[/url]. Consider setting up your category if you're going to stream on Twitch.tv!
